Bill Status - Batch notification on GovInfo https://www.govinfo.gov/bulkdata/BILLSTATUS New xml files available on the GovInfo bulk data repository for Congressional Bill Status. At the direction of the U.S. House of Representatives Appropriations Committee, in support of the Legislative Branch Bulk Data Task Force, the Government Publishing Office (GPO), the Library of Congress (LOC), the Clerk of the House, and the Secretary of the Senate are making Bill Status information in XML format available through the GPO’s Bulk Data repository starting with the 113th Congress.
